welcome.title: Thanks for helping out
welcome.body: You'll read about 70 short cards aloud, about 20 minutes in all. Find a quiet spot, ideally on your own, and speak the way you normally do; every accent helps. A few cards look a little off on purpose, so read every card exactly as written, even if it looks wrong. You're not being tested. The app is. You can pause and pick it up later.
consent.title: Before you start
consent.declined: No problem, and thanks for considering it. Nothing was recorded, so you can close this page.
background.title: A little about you
background.intro: Quick questions about you. The first two help DJ see how results differ across kinds of speakers. The last two set how the cards look. You can pick Prefer not to say on the first two.
background.background.label: How would you describe yourself as a Mandarin speaker?
background.background.native: Native speaker: Mandarin was my first language
background.background.heritage: Heritage speaker: I grew up with Mandarin at home, and English became my main language
background.background.learner: Learner: I picked it up later
background.grew_up_hearing.label: Which Mandarin did you mostly hear growing up?
background.reading.label: How would you like to see the cards?
background.script.label: Which characters do you read more easily?
mic.title: Check your microphone
mic.body: Your phone will ask to use the microphone. Tap Allow. Your recordings stay on your phone until you choose to share them.
mic.checking: Say a few words in your normal voice. We're checking the sound level.
mic.level_low: A bit quiet. Hold the phone closer, or speak up a little.
mic.noisy: A little noisy. That's fine, or move somewhere quieter if it's easy.
card.isolated_hint: Say it by itself, like you're telling someone how it's pronounced.
card.phrase_hint: Say it naturally, like part of a conversation.
card.finish_early: Finish and send what I have
card.finish_early_confirm: Finish now? The cards you haven't recorded will count as skipped.
pause.title: Taking a break?
pause.body: Your recordings so far are saved on this phone. Open the same link in Safari within a few days and you'll pick up where you left off.
done.title: All done. Thank you!
done.body: That's every card. Tap Share with DJ to send your recordings. If it doesn't go through, you can send again. Once DJ has them, you can delete your copy.
done.code_note: Keep this code if you ever want your recordings deleted: just send it to DJ. It's also in the name of the file you share.
done.delete_confirm: Delete your recordings and answers from this phone? This can't be undone. DJ keeps what you already sent; to have DJ delete it too, send DJ your code.
done.deleted: Deleted from this phone. Thank you again for helping. To have DJ delete what you sent, send DJ your code.
share.fallback: Save to Files, then send it to DJ
error.mic_blocked: The microphone is blocked. Open Settings, tap Apps, then Safari, then Microphone, and choose Allow. Then reload this page.
error.unsupported: This page needs Safari on an iPhone. If you opened it inside another app, tap the ⋯ or share button and choose Open in Safari.
error.in_app_browser: Please open this page in Safari. It opened inside another app, where recording or sharing may not work. Tap the ⋯ or share button, then choose Open in Safari.
error.storage: This page can't save your recordings on your phone. That can happen in a Private tab or when storage is full. Try a normal Safari tab, then reload.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Reload the page; your recordings so far should still be there. If it keeps happening, tell DJ.
